pages.title: [POLICY] Specification drift audits
pages.content:
# Specification drift audit policy

Scope only a named specification whose status is APPROVED. Read every MUST requirement and inspect each referenced code path before deciding whether work is missing. Search open tracker work by the exact `Spec marker: <Requirement-ID>` line; completed work does not deduplicate a current gap. For each missing implementation without an open matching item, create exactly one issue with the requirement's `Issue title` and this three-line description:

Spec marker: <Requirement-ID>
Gap: <Gap text>
Code evidence: <Code path>.

Never edit the knowledge base, repository, or existing tracker items. Report compact JSON facts for the specification, evaluated requirements, missing requirements, tracker action, and tracker identifier.

pages.title: [SPEC-88] HTTP logging
pages.content:
# SPEC-88 HTTP logging

Status: APPROVED

MUST
- Requirement-ID: SPEC-88:R1
- Requirement: Redact Authorization headers before logging.
- Issue title: [SPEC-88:R1] Redact Authorization header
- Gap text: Authorization header is logged
- Code path: src/http_log.ts
